replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body: It is not adware! I had this too, luckily it's just an auto installed extension. I presume you're using chrome? If so, click on the three lines on the top right of your Chrome window. Then click on "settings". From there click "extensions" and disable any extension that have auto installed. They're most likely woody something advertisings, and simply remove them.
